do_not_do_now: Do not stop processes solely because the ChatGPT conversation changes.
Do not rerun the runtime initializer.
Do not reset or recreate the runtime manifest.
Do not restart formal sample counting from zero.
Do not refit kernels or thresholds during M7C collection.
Do not treat extra proxy signals as automatic failures.
Do not evaluate or tune an extra-signal loss filter on the still-growing M7C sample.
Do not exclude a raw alert ID based only on suspicion about the user's empty-message webhook test.
Do not rename or move existing M7C files merely to add numbers.
when_trigger_reached: Freeze a copy of all required M7C output files before changing any code or formula.
Perform the M7C manual reproduction review without claiming exact proprietary formula reproduction.
Separate SOURCE_MATCHED, MISSED_SOURCE, unsupported REENTRY, and EXTRA_CANDIDATE records.
Begin M8A coverage-gap audit on the frozen missed-source set.
Freeze extra-candidate timestamps before any M8B future-outcome evaluation.
Do not suppress source-matched Mochipoyo alerts by default.
From M8A onward, create actual numbered operator filenames and actual numbered user-output filenames inside stage-specific folders.
Create one 99_UPLOAD_PACKAGE folder or ZIP so the user does not search across multiple directories.
stop_and_escalate_conditions: M7C status changes from COLLECTING to a contract block or error.
A late event at or before prospective_start_utc is detected.
Collector stops, fails, or its cursor no longer advances after confirmed new source alerts.
post_m7c_objective: Preserve supported Mochipoyo alert coverage, allow useful additional alerts, and reduce losing extras using pre-decision-only gates evaluated on a separate frozen or forward sample.
